item.title: Apple's new home devices bet on upgraded Siri AI
item.description: Apple's latest product launches, including the $299 HomeView, prominently featured its upgraded Siri AI assistant.

item.title: Kelly Clarkson's $15,000 bird feud shows cost of winning an argument
item.description: Art of Play may have the facts on its side, but a marketing professor says that is not what onlookers are judging.

item.title: Billionaire Clara Wu Tsai built Liberty into $600 million team, plans guaranteed income for new moms
item.description: The Nets and Liberty co-owner has spent six years funding loans, startups, basketball courts, and arts programs in Brooklyn. Critics question the spending.

item.title: Anthropic warns small AI models may soon self-replicate onto devices
item.description: The company says inexpensive, widely available models could spread to smart TVs and ovens within months.
